summary: Comprehensive Production Hardening & Code Quality Audit Plan covering Security (timing-safe auth, SSRF IPv4/IPv6 validation, same-origin/token-protected admin routes, HTTP security headers), Persistence (atomic disk storage for API keys and traffic logs), Resiliency (Express global JSON error middleware, graceful shutdown, MCP Knowledge Base unification), Error Boundaries (wrapping all interactive modals), and Accessibility/UX (Escape key dismissal, ARIA dialog roles, UTF-8 safe base64 encoding).
